content.text:
According to the lead paragraph, Rust was created by software developer **Graydon Hoare**. The lead says he created it in 2006 while working at Mozilla.

I navigated to the English Wikipedia article and read the accessibility snapshot. The lead paragraph is the opening text under the title, which begins "Rust is a general-purpose programming language…". The creator sentence is the second paragraph of the lead.
